calibration_scope.scope: eps bounds the initialization at the control's execution calibrations; applying it to the plan plan assumes that initialization channel unchanged until the plan shots run

rule.bounds: one-sided Clopper-Pearson over every controlled qubit: x_history upper and prep0 lower at 2e-05s
rule.eps: u / ((1 - u)(1 - delta)), u = max(0, (U - b) / (1 - e01 - b)), b = min(prep0_2e-05s_lower, e10), delta = max(x_error + (x_duration + measure_duration) / T1) over the x_history execution calibrations; each PUB's segment-leading shots are counted at their worst value
rule.joint: marginal coverage under independent local preparation channels; joint_coincidences is a diagnostic outside the bound family
rule.readout: e10 the smallest and e01 the largest of the plan model's and every execution calibration's reported values
